raw: {"found":true,"passages":["Surgical agrees that all Work Product shall be the sole and exclusive property of Imprimis.","If and to the extent that any Work Product is found as a matter of law not to be a \"work made for hire\" within the meaning of the Act, Surgical agrees to assign, and by this Agreement and Surgical's signature below, Surgical hereby does assign to Imprimis all right, title and interest in and to Work Product, and all copies thereof, and the copyright, patent, trademark, trade secret and all other proprietary rights in Work Product."]}
